name: Phosophurs Undetectable Pathfinder
description: An experimental Geometry Dash pathfinding and input tool with configurable controls and realistic click audio.

humanised-clicks-enabled.name: Humanised mouse clicks
humanised-clicks-enabled.description: Randomly vary the position of ordinary mouse clicks. Frame-perfect clicks are never moved.

humanised-click-strength.name: Randomisation radius (pixels)
humanised-click-strength.description: Maximum distance from the intended mouse click position. Set to 0 for no offset.

autoplay-key.name: Toggle autoplay
autoplay-key.description: Starts or stops the pathfinder. Default: 4.

menu-key.name: Open / close menu
menu-key.description: Opens the mod settings. Default: Z.

click-sounds-enabled.name: Enable click sounds everywhere
click-sounds-enabled.description: Master switch for all keyboard and mouse click sounds.

keyboard-clicks-enabled.name: Keyboard click sounds
keyboard-clicks-enabled.description: Play a realistic keyboard-style click for keyboard inputs.

mouse-clicks-enabled.name: Mouse click sounds
mouse-clicks-enabled.description: Play a realistic mouse-button click for mouse inputs.

waveform-variation.name: Subtle waveform variation
waveform-variation.description: Vary the waveform slightly between clicks while keeping the same overall sound.

progress-mistakes-enabled.name: Enable progress-based input variation
progress-mistakes-enabled.description: Enables intentional random input variations for testing.

progress-start.name: Start percentage
progress-start.description: Begin input variation at this level percentage.

mistake-chance.name: Mistake probability
mistake-chance.description: Chance from 0 to 100 for an eligible input to be varied.
